standard_prerequisites.name: Direct sum decompositions and free direct summands
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows the module to be split off step by step into finite free pieces.

standard_prerequisites.name: The stated property applied to complements
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the next finite free direct summand containing the image of the next generator.

core_obligations: Enumerate a countable generating set and construct finite free direct summands F_1, F_2, ... such that the sum of the first n contains the first n generators (proof lines 20840-20844).

At the induction step, write M as the sum of the previously found pieces plus a complement N, take the image x of the next generator in N, and use the hypothesis to find a free direct summand of N containing x (proof lines 20845-20851).
Shrink that summand to a finite free one if necessary and conclude that M is the direct sum of the F_i, hence free (proof lines 20852-20854).
proof_roadmap: Build the finite free summands one generator at a time (proof lines 20839-20844).
At each step split off a complement and apply the hypothesis inside it (proof lines 20845-20854).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a countably generated module M is free provided that whenever M splits as N plus a finite free module, every element of N lies in a free direct summand of N (statement lines 20831-20837). The proof does not produce a basis at once: it enumerates the generators and inductively constructs finite free direct summands F_1, F_2, ... whose partial sums swallow one more generator at each step, at the induction step splitting off a complement N and applying the hypothesis to the image of the next generator inside N, then shrinking the resulting summand to a finite free one (proof lines 20839-20855). Keeping the construction inside the complement at each step is the content, and the author writes the induction out. H2.
